blocks.text: `if` can also produce a value: `if condition then A else B`. You assign the result straight to a variable. `else` is required and all branches must have the **same** type.

code: grade = if score >= 90 then "A" elif score >= 70 then "B" else "C"

blocks.prompt: Write the variable `sign` with `if ... then ... else`: `-1` when `n` is negative, otherwise `1`. Print it.

blocks.why: An `if` that produces a value must give one in every case.
